translations.definition: n. 民調、投票、投票所  v. 進行民調、獲得選票

examples.en: A recent poll shows that consumer confidence has dropped for the third consecutive month.

translations.zh-TW: 最近一項民調顯示，消費者信心已連續第三個月下滑。

examples.en: Analysts polled executives across fifty firms before publishing the annual leadership report.

translations.zh-TW: 分析師調查了五十家企業的高階主管，才發布這份年度領導力報告。

examples.en: Polling stations opened at seven in the morning and closed without major incidents reported.

translations.zh-TW: 投票所在早上七點開放，關閉時未傳出重大事故。

translations.definition: n. 工廠、工程、著作、作品（work 的複數）

examples.en: A steel works just outside the city announced plans to add a second production line.

translations.zh-TW: 市郊一家鋼鐵廠宣布計畫增設第二條生產線。

examples.en: Engineers at the public works department are repairing bridges damaged by last month's storm.

translations.zh-TW: 公共工程部的工程師正在維修上個月風暴損壞的橋梁。

examples.en: The gallery is exhibiting selected works from contemporary East Asian sculptors.

translations.zh-TW: 這家美術館正展出當代東亞雕塑家的精選作品。

translations.definition: a. 可以的、沒問題的  adv. 還好、可以

examples.en: If the revised timeline is okay with the team, we will submit the contract by Friday.

translations.zh-TW: 如果團隊同意修改後的時間表，我們會在週五前提交合約。

examples.en: The supplier said an early delivery would be okay as long as we cover the express shipping fee.

translations.zh-TW: 供應商表示，只要我們負擔快遞運費，提前交貨是沒問題的。

examples.en: After the audit, the regulatory body confirmed that our records are okay and require no correction.

translations.zh-TW: 稽核後，監管機構確認我們的帳目資料沒有問題，且無需更正。

translations.definition: n. 蹤跡、小徑  v. 追蹤、尾隨、落後

examples.en: The audit trail lets accountants reconstruct every posted transaction in chronological order.

translations.zh-TW: 稽核軌跡讓會計人員能按時間順序，重建每一筆已過帳的交易。

examples.en: Conservative investors prefer mutual funds that trail the broad market by only a small margin.

translations.zh-TW: 保守型投資人偏好僅小幅落後大盤的共同基金。

examples.en: Trailing behind the industry leader in market share, the firm is now investing heavily in marketing.

translations.zh-TW: 在市佔率上落後產業龍頭之後，這家公司現在正大舉投資行銷。

translations.definition: n. 伊拉克人  a. 伊拉克的、伊拉克人的

examples.en: Iraqi oil exports to neighboring countries have nearly doubled this quarter.

translations.zh-TW: 本季伊拉克對鄰國的石油出口幾乎翻了一倍。

examples.en: Many Iraqi engineers trained abroad are returning home to rebuild the energy sector.

translations.zh-TW: 許多曾在海外受訓的伊拉克工程師，正陸續回國協助重建能源產業。

examples.en: A joint venture between an Iraqi firm and a European investor will construct new refineries in Basra.

translations.zh-TW: 一家伊拉克公司與歐洲投資人合資，將在巴士拉興建新的煉油廠。

examples.en: A financial analyst downgraded the stock after the company missed its quarterly forecast.

translations.zh-TW: 在公司未達季度預期後，一位財務分析師下調了該股票評等。

examples.en: Industry analysts expect global EV sales to outpace traditional cars in this decade.

translations.zh-TW: 業界分析師預期，全球電動車銷量將在這十年內超越傳統汽車。

examples.en: The senior analyst briefs interns on how to read balance sheets every Monday morning.

translations.zh-TW: 每位週一早上，這位資深分析師都會向實習生說明如何閱讀資產負債表。

translations.definition: adv. 不再、再也（不用於肯定句）

examples.en: Traditional travel agencies do not thrive anymore, as most customers book flights online.

translations.zh-TW: 傳統旅行社已不再蓬勃發展，因為多數顧客都在網路上預訂機票。

examples.en: The office does not accept cash payments anymore, given the rise of digital invoicing.

translations.zh-TW: 由於數位發票日益普及，該辦公室已不再接受現金付款。

examples.en: Our warehouse manager cannot rely on paper records anymore, after the company-wide digital migration.

translations.zh-TW: 在全公司數位化之後，倉庫經理再也無法依賴紙本紀錄了。

examples.en: A foreign investor has agreed to fund the next stage of the renewable energy project.

translations.zh-TW: 一位外國投資人已同意為這項再生能源計畫的下一階段提供資金。

examples.en: Institutional investors are demanding greater transparency in executive compensation disclosures.

translations.zh-TW: 機構投資人正要求在執行長薪酬揭露上提供更高的透明度。

examples.en: Each investor receives quarterly statements detailing the performance of their portfolio.

translations.zh-TW: 每位投資人都會收到詳列其投資組合績效的季度報告書。

translations.definition: n. 日本人、日語  a. 日本的、日語的

examples.en: The Japanese automaker will recall 200,000 vehicles to fix a brake defect.

translations.zh-TW: 這家日本汽車製造商將召回二十萬輛車，以修復煞車瑕疵。

examples.en: Many Japanese companies still reward long-serving staff with lifetime employment guarantees.

translations.zh-TW: 許多日本公司仍以終身雇用制來獎勵資深員工。

examples.en: Our HR team hired a Japanese tutor so that engineers can read the supplier's documentation directly.

translations.zh-TW: 人資團隊聘用了一位日語家教，讓工程師能直接閱讀供應商的技術文件。

translations.definition: a. 種族的、民族的、人種的

examples.en: An ethnic grocery store chain expanded to fifteen locations in just two years.

translations.zh-TW: 一家民族特色食品雜貨連鎖店，在短短兩年內擴展到十五個據點。

examples.en: Recruiters aim to build a workforce that represents the ethnic diversity of the surrounding community.

translations.zh-TW: 招募人員致力於建立一支能反映鄰近社區種族多樣性的員工團隊。

examples.en: Marketing campaigns avoid imagery that stereotypes any ethnic group in negative ways.

translations.zh-TW: 行銷活動刻意避免任何刻板印象化特定族群、呈現負面形象的影像。
